response.overview: VHS (Video Home System) used to be the most widely used recording and viewing device, although today VHS can be considered a dead medium because of the new and higher quality media, it is still different from the media of later generations with low noise waves and low definition quality. Therefore, the animation obtained from VHS is like a projection of the distant past that reflects the development of motion pictures in the pre-1970s. 2000  But with the development of technology, animation has changed rapidly.
